name: FAQ, tabs by topic
description: Topic tabs, each with its own accordion of questions. Without JavaScript all topics show in a list.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Pick a topic to see the questions we hear most.

questions.question: Which video tools does Fieldnote work with?
questions.answer: Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. For in-person sessions, upload audio or video files from any phone or recorder.

questions.question: How accurate are the transcripts?
questions.answer: Around 95% for clear audio, with a label for every speaker. You can fix any line, and Fieldnote learns your product names as you go.

questions.question: Can we tag interviews with our own themes?
questions.answer: Create your own tag sets for each project, or start from our templates for onboarding, churn and pricing research.

questions.question: Where do you store our recordings?
questions.answer: In the region you pick when you sign up: Canada, the EU or the US. Everything is encrypted at rest and in transit.

questions.question: Is Fieldnote SOC 2 compliant?
questions.answer: Yes. We pass a SOC 2 Type II audit every year and share the report under NDA as part of our security pack.

questions.question: Can we delete a recording for good?
questions.answer: Yes. Deleting removes the video, audio and transcript right away, and our backups forget it within 30 days.

questions.question: How does the free trial work?
questions.answer: You get every feature for 14 days and up to ten interviews. No credit card, and nothing is deleted when the trial ends.

questions.question: Do you charge for every seat?
questions.answer: Only for people who run interviews. Teammates who watch highlights and leave comments are free on every plan.

questions.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: All major credit cards, and invoices paid by bank transfer on annual plans.

default.question: How long does it take to set up Fieldnote?
default.answer: Most teams record their first interview the same day. Connect your calendar and video tool, invite your team, and Fieldnote joins the next call you schedule.
